summary: Backtest completed. No reliable improvement over the market baseline; picks remain locked.
sample_summary: Seven-day archive audit: 2642 result records; 995 eligible non-virtual fixtures. 360 histories checked; 357 paired games. Trained on 221, tested on 108; 28 overlapping outcomes excluded from training.

calibration_experiment.approach: Market probability calibration with regularized logistic offset
calibration_experiment.split: Chronological by decision time; training outcome-record timestamps must predate first evaluation decision.

blockers: The model's small Brier-score improvement is uncertain: fixture-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00109, 0.00290] includes zero.
Each league has too few held-out games for reliable league-specific approval. No league has 50 held-out games in this sample.
Reference quotes have not been directly cross-checked against each bookmaker event and its specific rules.
settlement_reference: General bet365 AU rules reviewed: in-play Game bets include overtime and two-way markets can push. Exact fixture-specific rules are not independently confirmed.
backtest_limitations: One week and a pooled multi-league sample, not a long-term or prospective performance study.
Only first same-timestamp paired half-point Game/Line observations were used; whole-number lines and pushes are outside this experiment.
Finished scores and odds come from the same third-party provider; independent official settlement reconciliation is not complete.
Fixture bootstrap is exploratory and does not model all within-team, league or temporal dependence.
Price histories in the initial 12-fixture audit had no contemporaneous score or clock, so these records alone do not support a score/time model.
